currency_assumptions: All amounts are published in USD by the venues themselves; no currency conversion was required anywhere in this package, so the rate basis is 'no conversion applied (source currency USD)'.

Where a venue publishes an hourly rate and the package records an eight-hour figure, the figure is the published rate multiplied by the assessed 8-hour duration and is described as such in evidence.observed_facts; it is not a quoted package price.

San Francisco venue prices are commonly tiered (package bands, weekday vs weekend, member vs non-profit) or quote-only; each venue records the exact tier used and what that tier excludes (staffing, AV, cleaning, security, deposit, insurance).
Soft budget for scoring is USD 5,000 per the plan-event default; cost is never a tier gate.

evidence.observed_facts: The BMB page states 'Die Tage vom 27. Oktober bis 31. Oktober werden gesetzlich als Herbstferien festgelegt.'; in 2027 that span is Wednesday 27 October to Sunday 31 October. The page names an opt-out ordinance for Bildungsdirektionen in special cases; no Vienna opt-out is published on the directorate page, and school-autonomous days are separate per-school days, so the statutory span is recorded. The page anchors the rule in 'Schulzeitgesetz 1985, BGBl. I Nr. 77/1985'; the § 2 Abs 4 Z 8 wording was read from the RIS consolidated text through the search backend's fetch because direct access to ris.bka.gv.at answers HTTP 503 from the curation host.

evidence.observed_facts: Schulzeitgesetz 1985 § 2 Abs 4 Z 3 makes 24 December to 6 January the statutory Christmas school-free period in every year; in 2027/28 that is Friday 24 December 2027 to Thursday 6 January 2028. The optional 23 December extension applies only when 23 December is a Monday (it is a Thursday in 2027), and no ordinance declaring 23 December 2027 or 7 January 2028 free is published, so the statutory span is recorded. The Vienna 2027/28 school-year edition is not published, so this row rests on the statute alone.

holidays.source_edition: Schulzeitgesetz 1985 § 2 Abs 4 Z 3, RIS-Fassung vom 21.10.2026
holidays.source_locator: § 2 Abs 4 Z 3: 'die Tage vom 24. Dezember bis einschließlich 6. Jänner (Weihnachtsferien); der 23. Dezember, sofern er auf einen Montag fällt; überdies können der 23. Dezember sowie der 7. Jänner, wenn es für einzelne Schulen aus Gründen der Ab- oder Anreise der Schüler zweckmäßig ist, von der zuständigen Schulbehörde durch Verordnung schulfrei erklärt werden'
holidays.source_title: Schulzeitgesetz 1985 - Bundesrecht konsolidiert, Fassung vom 21.10.2026

evidence.observed_facts: Schulzeitgesetz 1985 § 2 Abs 4 Z 2 declares 'der Allerseelentag' school-free, and the BMB page lists 'der Allerseelentag (2. November)' under 'Schulfrei sind - abgesehen von den Sonntagen -'. The date is fixed at 2 November in every year, so the 2027 occurrence is Tuesday 2 November 2027. Allerseelen is not one of Austria's statutory public holidays (the AT public layer carries the thirteen gesetzliche Feiertage and none falls on 2 November), so the day is recorded here as a school_holiday row. The Vienna directorate 2026/2027 page lists the same date in its 'Schulfreie Tage' section for 2026 ('Allerheiligen, Allerseelen: Sonntag, 1. November und Montag, 2. November 2026'), confirming that Vienna observes it. Direct access to ris.bka.gv.at from the curation host answers HTTP 503, so the wording was read through the search backend's fetch of the consolidated page https://www.ris.bka.gv.at/GeltendeFassung.wxe?Abfrage=Bundesnormen&Gesetzesnummer=10009575. That page's 'Fassung vom' header label was not stable across fetches on 2026-11-20 (21.10.2026, 18.11.2026 and 19.11.2026 were each printed by a fetch of the same URL), so this row cites the statute by Gesetzesnummer and asserts no Fassung date.

evidence.observed_facts: The school-year regulation fixes the winter Christmas break as 23–31 December in every year, with an earlier 22 December start only when 22 December is a Monday. In 2027/28 22 December is a Wednesday, so the statutory span is Thursday 23 December to Friday 31 December 2027. The full MEN 2027/2028 calendar is not published; the only 2027/2028 item on the ministry's calendar index is the winter-break announcement, which places mazowieckie on 31 January–13 February 2028, outside this window.

evidence.observed_facts: The MŠMT 2026/2027 edition prints 'Vánoční prázdniny začínají ve středu 23. prosince 2026 a končí v neděli 3. ledna 2027.' and names Monday 4 January 2027 as the day teaching resumes. The row keeps the stated full bounds although it starts before the 2027-01-01 window start. Vyhláška 16/2005 Sb. § 4 odst. 3 fixes the break as 23 December to 2 January inclusive with an end extension only when 3 January is a Friday; in 2026/27 2 January is a Saturday, so the ministry's stated Sunday end adds only the weekend day on which no teaching takes place.

evidence.observed_facts: Article 5, paragraph 1, item 2 of the metropolitan rule fixes the 冬季休業日 as 26 December to 7 January, so the 2026/2027 winter break runs 2026-12-26 to 2027-01-07; the row keeps the stated full bounds although it starts before the 2027-01-01 window start. Paragraph 3 permits a principal-set variation only for the spring break and for the summer and winter breaks of fisheries and agriculture full-time courses and of part-time courses, so the ordinary high-school winter bound is the rule's own date.

blockers.text: Cost is an estimate from a published rate, not a quote.

evidence.inference: The cheapest published-rate option found in San Francisco (a community arts facility offering 'below-market rates'), with a theatre-sized room. It is recorded as a lead rather than shortlist_ready because the seated capacity is only evidenced by third-party listings and not by CounterPulse's own rentals page, and because the $50/hour 'private event' rate is not accompanied by any stated staffing, insurance or access terms.
evidence.observed_facts: Official CounterPulse rentals page (counterpulse.org/rentals/, rendered 2026-11-20): 'Rent space at CounterPulse! ... Now accepting rentals for rehearsals, classes, workshops, and private events'; published rates 'Main Stage Rehearsal - $25/hr', 'Main Stage Class or Workshop - $40/hr', 'Main Stage Private Event - $50/hr', 'Upstairs Studio Rehearsal - $23/hr', 'Upstairs Studio Class - $26/hr', 'Upstairs Studio Private Event - $28/hr', 'Project Space Rehearsal - $22/hr', 'Project Space - $750 per week', 'Project Space - $1500 per month'. Address 80 Turk St, San Francisco, CA 94102; all spaces described as fully ADA accessible. Third-party listings (cvent.com venue page for CounterPULSE; thevendry.com) give Main Stage seated 108 / standing 149 and three meeting rooms, largest 1,350 sq ft. The eight-hour USD figure is the published $50/hour private-event rate multiplied by 8.

evidence.observed_facts: Official AFSF theater rental page (afsf.com/about-afsf/space-rental/theater-rental/, fetched 2026-11-20): 'The Alliance Francaise de San Francisco (AFSF) performing arts venue seats 74 guests'; 'The venue is configured for seated events and is suitable for the following event types: presentations, conferences (with or without slideshow), and movie screenings.' Fee schedule: evening rentals Independent Artists $700 base + $150 catering + $290 staffing; Nonprofits $800 + $150 + $290; Private Events $1,250 + $200 + $290. Daytime: Independent Artists $450, Nonprofits $550, Private Events $800, plus $150/$200 catering surcharge, with 'No additional staffing fee ... as AFSF staff are already on site during opening hours.' 'Daytime Availability (regular business days and hours) Monday to Friday 10:00 am - 5:00 pm; Saturday 10:00 am - 2:00 pm'. 'Saturday 1-5pm, Sunday 9-5 and holidays additional Fee Schedule. Front desk staffing is mandatory and charged at $60 per hour.' 'A refundable security deposit of $300 is required.' Address 1345 Bush Street, San Francisco, CA 94109.
